environment.description: Provider binary executes on the same Ubuntu 22.04 CI runner but the systemd unit for the Terraform worker process specifies PrivateTmp=yes combined with a custom AppArmor profile loaded in enforce mode. The profile (terraform-provider-certdeploy) uses a narrow file rule set: it grants 'owner rwk' on '/tmp/terraform-cert-deploy/**' but critically includes 'deny other /tmp/terraform-cert-deploy/** r,' which prevents any non-owner process from reading files in that subtree. The profile also includes 'deny /tmp/terraform-cert-deploy/** l,' blocking hard-link creation by any subject. The PrivateTmp=yes directive means the actual path is /tmp/.private/terraform-worker-<uuid>/terraform-cert-deploy/ which is bind-mounted, so the predictable path '/tmp/terraform-cert-deploy' resolves to an isolated mount point invisible to other processes in different mount namespaces.
